Domed_Glass_Braincase.description: Encased within a translucent dome of enchanted glass, the Domed_Glass_Braincase houses a construct's intricate neural pathways, amplifying its wisdom while paradoxically leaving it vulnerable to the physical world's harsh realities.

Sloped_Iron_Defensive_Helm.description: Forged from the darkest iron and enchanted with ancient runes, the Sloped Iron Defensive Helm is a formidable construct that clings to the wearer’s head like a second skull, enhancing their natural resilience and fortitude, while granting the skill to block incoming attacks with unparalleled efficiency.

Intricate_Clockwork_Cranium.description: The Intricate_Clockwork_Cranium is a marvel of arcane engineering, a mechanical marvel encased in glistening brass and gears that whir and click, enhancing the wearer's agility and wisdom while granting them an uncanny ability to remain ever-vigilant in the most dire of circumstances.

Carved_Runestone_Skull.description: The Carved Runestone Skull is a formidable construct, its stone cranium etched with ancient runes that hum with latent magical energy, enhancing its strength and wisdom while granting resistance to magical attacks.

Stitched_Flesh_Cerebral_Cavity.description: The Stitched Flesh Cerebral Cavity is a gruesome construct of interwoven, pallid flesh and sinew that pulsates with a sickly glow within the cranium, enhancing its mental fortitude while instilling a visceral dread in all who witness its unnatural form.

Gargoyle_Horned_Stone_Cranium.description: This gargantuan stone cranium, fused with the essence of an ancient gargoyle, boasts an unnerving visage and a natural resilience that grants its bearer increased strength and a layer of impenetrable armor, while its fearsome gaze and menacing horns empower the wielder with the primal skills of Gore and Fear.

Polished_Porcelain_Doll_Head.description: This finely crafted ceramic doll head, with its delicate porcelain features and lifelike expression, exudes an otherworldly charm that captivates those who gaze upon it, while subtly enhancing the wearer's charisma and charisma-based abilities, though it comes at the cost of a slight decrease in physical resilience.

Scrap_Metal_Bucket_Skull.description: This Scrap_Metal_Bucket_Skull, a crude and formidable construct, is a twisted amalgamation of jagged scrap metal fused into the semblance of a skull, offering a rugged resilience that boosts its bearer's constitution while its ominous and unnatural appearance drains the charisma of those around it.

Crystal_Prism_Sensor_Dome.description: Embedded within the crystalline dome that serves as its head, the Crystal Prism Sensor Dome harnesses ancient magic to enhance its perception and wisdom, casting radiant prismatic light that illuminates the darkest corners and reveals hidden threats with eerie clarity.

Steam_Venting_Boiler_Head.description: The Steam_Venting_Boiler_Head is a colossal construct cranium, its metal plates hissing and venting scalding steam, radiating an aura of oppressive heat and raw power that intimidates all who dare approach, enhancing the wielder's strength while quelling the finer aspects of charm and diplomacy.
